Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Alhamdu Lillah, Wa Ash-hadu Alla Elaha Ella Allah Wahdahu La Shareeka Lah.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Praise be to God

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and we bear witness that there is only one God.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: I want to start my Khutba,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: this time with the beautiful quotation from the Bible,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: from Luke 12: 29-31.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: It is, of course, a Quranic idea. The author is One and the same.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And this is expressed beautifully in English.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Starting at 29, it says "it is not for you to be in search of what you are to eat or drink.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Stop worrying.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: The unbelievers of this world are always running after these things.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: God knows that you need such things.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Seek out, instead, His kingship over you.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and the rest will follow, in turn."

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So all you need to do is seek God's kingship over you and everything else you need, follows,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: the food, the provisions, the clothing, the health.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Everything else follows.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So, what does this mean? What does seeking God's kingship mean?

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: It means that you give priority to God's commandments.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You give priority to the 5 contact prayers.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You wake up in the morning and you say "my duty today is to do the 5 contact prayers."

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: That you... the Friday prayer is a commandment from God. There is a commandment in Sura 60, verse 9

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: that you must go to the Friday prayer. You give this priority.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You arrange your life and your job and your circumstances

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: so you will do the 5 daily prayers and the Friday prayer.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And of course, you people here are the least people who need this.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Some people out there are the ones who need this kind of reminder.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You put on the list of your priorities, the Quranic study.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: There's a Quranic study, every Friday night, going on here, where we study the word of God

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and you have to work your circumstances.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You cannot be somewhere in Tucson and there's a Quranic study going on somewhere in the mosque.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Otherwise, you don't really care.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You're not seeking God's kingship over you,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: to be sitting within, say 50 miles,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and there's a Quranic study going on.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: What does it mean to seek God's kingship over you and everything else follows, the provisions, the health, the happiness?

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You give priority to the activities of the believers.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You remember the verse in Sura 18 that says "force yourself to be with those who worship God Alone."

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Because it takes some effort and some work. It's not easy.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: But this is what is good for you, as you will see in the second KHUTBAH, Insha Allah.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: It means that

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: you make a point of giving out the ZAKAT charity

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: as commanded by God.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: This is how you seek God's kingship over you

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: one day in the year, whatever, January first, December 31st, the first day of Ramadan, any day you set for yourself,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: one day in the year, you calculate exactly how much you are worth

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and you give out 2.5% to people that you know personally,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: people who need your charity.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And the Quran gives the exact order:

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: your parents, first. If they don't need it, then your relatives

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: your cousins, your brothers, sisters.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: I mean your genetic brothers and sisters.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And if all your relatives are rich, they don't need it, then you go to the orphans,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: children who have no support

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: one of the parents is missing somehow

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and after that, the traveling stranger.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Somebody stranded from Mexico or Nicaragua or whatever and passes by your house

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: or you know personally

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: people who immigrated from Thailand or Vietnam and they're living in a house in a terrible conditions and you know them.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Then, they come next.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So, there is a specific sequence or order to give out this charity.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You give priority to Hajj eventually

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: not now. I wouldn't advise you to do it now.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: The Quran makes it conditional.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Someday all of us, IN SHAA ALLAH, we'll go. We're gonna charter a plane when we'll go, all of us, we'll make Hajj.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And we'll go in as will be great victory because the land over there will be worshiping God alone.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: This is God's promise to us and therefore, I can talk about it in this way.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So eventually, you'll have to observe Hajj.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You seek God's kingship over you,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and everything else follows by observing the prohibitions that God gave you.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You don't drink. You don't gamble. You don't eat pork.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You don't lie. You don't cheat.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You don't violate your promises.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You must be a person of your word.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You must be an example of a person of God,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: one, a member in God's kingdom.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Anything else in your life must take place number two.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You give priority to these activities, the commands of God

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and this way you seek God's kingship over you

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and this way you attain all other goals:

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: money, health, wealth, happiness, etc., etc.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Tooboo Ela Allah. Repent.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Alhamdu Lillah, Wa Ash-hadu Alla Elaha Ella Allah Wahdahu La Shareeka Lah.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: By studying the Quran continuously, we have discovered the secret of happiness.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: The secret of happiness is a developed, nourished and grown soul,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: the real you, the real person, not this body.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: This is the secret of happiness.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And we came to this conclusion by studying people who obtained everything.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: They got everything that the human beings go after:

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: money, fame, good looks, sports cars, whatever.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And I have used the example of Eddie Murphy,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: a movie star when he was interviewed by Barbara Walters.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: He's got millions of dollars. He's got palaces in California, exclusive places and in New Jersey,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: the five luxurious cars,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: all the girls, all the money, all the fame that he wants.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And he told Barbara Walters he was not happy.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So, what is the secret of happiness?

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Aren't these the things that people are going after

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: money and fame and wealth and whatever?

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And he is not happy.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So, the secret of happiness is that he must develop his soul.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And the soul can be developed by worshiping God alone.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Now, in this KHUTBA, I want to talk about God's name: AL-RAZAQ, the Provider.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: The Provider.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: God is the exclusive Provider.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: He is the One who decides how much money you're going to make, or you made from birth to death.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And I want to shed a whole new light on this word "the Provider"

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: because God provides for the body and for the soul.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Therefore, the contact prayers that you do five times a day are a provision from God.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: The duties that I talked about in the first KHUTBA, they're actually a gift from God.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And we see this... there's a lot of evidence in the Quran for this.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: For example, in Sura 7, verse 43,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: we see that the people in Heaven

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: pray and say "Alhamdu Lillah", "Praise be to God" who guided us to this.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: We could not, we could never be guided without God's blessing and guiding us."

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: In other words, it was not their doing.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: It is God's blessing and God's gift to them that guided them.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: In sura 10, verse 9,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: we see a very clear principle

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: saying that God guides the people because of their faith or their belief.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: In other words, when you decide to worship God alone, then God provides for your soul

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and God provides the five contact prayers for your soul

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and the fasting of the month of Ramadan for your soul.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: I mean, you think that you're gonna do the five contact prayers,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: but really it's a gift from God. You cannot do it without God's guidance.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Sura 9 verse 10. Sura 10, verse 9, excuse me.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: In sura 49, verse 17,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: another clear evidence for this.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: The verse says "they act as if they are doing you a favor by embracing Islam or by practicing Islam

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: instead, God is the one who blessed them by guiding them to Islam."

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So, when we worship God alone, when we do the five daily prayers, when we fast the month of Ramadan,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: when we join the Quranic study and even the picnics of the Muslim group,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: we are not doing God a favor.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: It is God's provisions to our souls.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: In sura 14, verse 40, we see Abraham praying

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and what is he saying?

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: He says, "please God make me an observer of the Contact Prayers"

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: because it's a gift from God.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: "and also my children" he said.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: He said "please God make me an observer of the Contact Prayers."

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ (14:40)

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: in Arabic.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: He didn't say, "please, God give me a million dollars."

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So, observing the five Contact Prayers is a privilege, and a gift and a blessing.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: It is not a hardship. It is not work.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: You get up for the morning prayer, before sunrise,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: not because you want to do this, or because you're doing such a great effort, you know, for God's sake.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: It's because God blessed you and enabled you

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: to get up before sunrise to feed your soul,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: this very important meal, the morning prayer.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: Abraham said " رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ" My Lord, make me one who observes the Contact Prayers,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and also my children.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: People in Satan's kingdom are provided with sins.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: We see this in Sura 24, verse 21.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: When Satan collects people in his kingdom,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: he pushes them to go to the bar and lie and cheat,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: and drink and do not feed your soul.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: This is what sins are: not feeding the soul, depriving the soul, poverty of the soul.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: On the other hand, in Sura 7, verse 28,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: we see the principle that God does not advocate vice.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: So, it's the exact opposite of what Satan does.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And this is why I want to remind you again that God never ordered Abraham to slaughter his son

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: because this is a terrible vice, of course.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And this is why we never, never find it in the Quran that Abraham ordered Abraham to sacrifice his son.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: That wouldn't make sense and it does not... this law that "God does not advocate sins" would be violated.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: People in Satan's kingdom, because of their idol worship,

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: they may observe the five Contact Prayers, but they do not make contact.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: They dial the wrong number.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: They dial Satan's number because they mention other names with God.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And this is a trick of Satan.

Video Title: 24 Friday Sermon by dr Rashad Khalifa Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows 1988
Text: And this is why we find in the Quran such statements as "woe to those who observe the Salat prayers."
